urls.title: URLs to monitor
urls.description: Pages to watch. The first run stores a baseline for each (free); later runs report changes. Up to 500 URLs per run.

cssSelector.title: CSS selector (optional)
cssSelector.description: Watch only this part of each page, e.g. .pricing-table. Leave empty to watch the page's main content with navigation, footers, and scripts stripped automatically.

pushUnchangedRows.title: Also push rows for unchanged pages
pushUnchangedRows.description: Push a status row for pages that did not change (never charged). Useful for audit trails.

includeFullText.title: Include previous and current text in change rows
includeFullText.description: Attach the previous and current extracted text (capped at 5000 characters each) to every change row, in addition to the added/removed lines.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Most monitored pages need no proxy.
